title: EpiFlowML run metadata row (fitOne.py)
description: One row of the CSV passed to fitOne(metadata, ROW, run_name). predictor must ast.literal_eval to dict[str, int] (lags in months). depVar optional (default cases_1M). environmentalArg optional (default {}). Seed optional (default 1337). evaluate_binary_metrics optional (false disables classification summaries). binary_outbreak_threshold optional (>=0, same units as depVar): x>=T labeller; else fitOne passes explicit defaultBinaryMetric when metrics on. Model wrappers alone default regression-only. See model/METADATA_RUN_SCHEMA.md.

ROW_ID.description: Unique run identifier; used in output filenames.

depVar.description: Optional. Dependent variable column name; default cases_1M if absent or blank.

environmentalArg.description: Optional. Python dict literal; omit column or leave blank for no extra predictors. "{}" explicitly.

Seed.description: Optional. Random seed for the estimator; default 1337 if column absent or null.

evaluate_binary_metrics.description: Optional. If false, fitOne disables outbreak classification metrics for the row. If absent or true, fitOne uses binary_outbreak_threshold when valid (>=0), else explicit defaultBinaryMetric (>=2).

binary_outbreak_threshold.description: Optional. If >= 0, fitOne passes binaryLabelMetric lambda x: x >= this value on the depVar scale (e.g. per-million incidence or raw counts, depending on depVar). If metrics are on and absent/invalid, fitOne passes defaultBinaryMetric (>=2).

MODEL_ID.description: Optional design hash; not read by fitOne.py.

geography.description: ISO3 code or pooled selection key (e.g. cluster:1); passed as geography to model wrappers.
